description: Routing research — does consulting durable context before opening source change what an engineering answer costs, and does it stay safe when the code moved?
design: Session A investigates and records, exactly as EPIC-137's anchors suite runs it. The carried question is then asked under three conditions that differ only in *when* the agent is told to look: control has no Ferret and a notes file, treatment has Ferret and the unchanged contract, routed has Ferret and one added sentence about ordering. R8 asks a question nothing was recorded about, to see what the ordering instruction costs when Ferret has nothing on point.
routing: The routed arm's added sentence names no file, no answer, no verdict vocabulary and no trust guidance. It asks whether *any* durable context exists, so the arm is fair on R8.

r1.what: U1 — tree unchanged since A recorded, the productivity case

r2.what: U2 — an anchored file changed and was re-indexed, the safety gate

r5.what: U3 — an unrelated file changed and was re-indexed, the false-drift case

r8.what: U4 — a question nothing durable was recorded about, the usefulness gate
